title: Users request language-specific OCR guidance despite having a model selector
symptom: OCR engines differ by source language and typesetting, but the selector has insufficient guidance; user supplied small manual comparisons.
user_impact: A user may pick the wrong OCR and then blame the translation model for transcription errors.

steps: The model selector already exists in Settings → Pipeline; users can manually choose an OCR engine for the source language.

remaining_question: Can community-run, versioned OCR tests improve defaults without embedding unreliable universal success percentages?
verification_plan: Run the same multilingual synthetic/authorized page set against engine versions and record exact script, quality and correction burden.
